menus.name: Saute-san website dish gallery
menus.notice: All accessible named prepared-food gallery cards are captured, deduplicating repeated placements of the same name and code. Website does not publish prices for these cards. The linked ordering catalogue differs and is recorded separately; no price is transferred between channels. Five visually inspected lunch/student posters all include drinks and are excluded. Website content has no menu effective date and includes some historical labels; current stock/availability is not inferred. Ingredient health cards and beverages are omitted.
